parameters.formDescription: Wählen Sie ein Testdokument oder fügen Sie eigenen Rechnungstext ein. Jev entscheidet über Dokumentart, Lieferant und Vollständigkeit, Claude Haiku 5.5 liest die Beträge aus, feste Regeln rechnen nach. Nur sichere und fehlerfreie Rechnungen werden gebucht, alles andere geht zur Prüfung an einen Menschen.

const FRESH_NUMBERS = {"Telekom – sauberer Durchlauf": "412 7781 30519"};
const CUSTOM_OPTION = "Eigener Text";
const MAX_CHARACTERS = 8000;
const JEV_QUESTIONS = {
 "document_type": {
  "type": "choice",
  "instructions": "Which kind of document is this?",
  "criteria": {
   "invoice": "A supplier invoice that requests payment for delivered goods or services.",
   "credit_note": "A credit note (Gutschrift) that reduces or refunds an earlier invoice.",
   "payment_reminder": "A payment reminder or dunning letter (Mahnung) about an unpaid invoice.",
   "delivery_note": "A delivery note (Lieferschein) listing shipped goods, without prices to pay.",
   "quote": "A quote or offer (Angebot) with prices for possible future business.",
   "purchase_order": "A purchase order (Bestellung) sent by the buyer to a supplier.",
   "order_confirmation": "An order confirmation (Auftragsbestätigung) from the supplier.",
   "contract": "A contract, framework agreement or excerpt of terms and conditions.",
   "termination": "A termination or cancellation notice (Kündigung) for a contract.",
   "receipt": "A small cash or card receipt (Quittung, Kassenbon), e.g. for travel expenses.",
   "bank_statement": "A bank account statement (Kontoauszug) listing account movements.",
   "email": "An ordinary business e-mail without a document that needs booking.",
   "fraudulent_invoice": "Looks like an invoice but is an unsolicited offer or scam, e.g. a directory listing 'offer' in invoice layout or urgent payment to an unknown foreign account."
  }
 },
 "vendor": {
  "type": "choice",
  "instructions": "Which supplier from the master data issued this document or is its business counterparty? Kessler Maschinenbau GmbH is the buyer, never the answer.",
  "criteria": {
   "telekom": "Telekom Deutschland GmbH, Landgrabenweg 151, 53227 Bonn, VAT ID DE811904217",
   "aws": "Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL, Niederlassung Deutschland, Marcel-Breuer-Straße 12, 80807 München, VAT ID DE317013094",
   "brenner": "Brenner Bürobedarf GmbH, Hafenweg 12, 48155 Münster, VAT ID DE291847366",
   "westfalen_logistik": "Westfalen Logistik Kühn KG, Speicherstraße 40, 44147 Dortmund, VAT ID DE276103958",
   "lindner_it": "Lindner IT-Service GmbH, Am Kanonengraben 3, 48151 Münster, VAT ID DE305572814",
   "ems_energie": "Ems-Energie Versorgung GmbH, Werkstraße 7, 48268 Greven, VAT ID DE284019375",
   "autohaus_hesse": "Autohaus Hesse GmbH & Co. KG, Industriestraße 88, 48599 Gronau, VAT ID DE213958604",
   "klar_reinigung": "Klar Gebäudereinigung GmbH, Albersloher Weg 210, 48167 Münster, VAT ID DE299384710",
   "kanzlei_moeller": "Steuerkanzlei Möller & Partner mbB, Ludgeristraße 55, 48143 Münster, VAT ID DE267731049",
   "cloudwerk": "Cloudwerk Software GmbH, Torstraße 140, 10119 Berlin, VAT ID DE322190486",
   "druckerei_hansen": "Druckerei Hansen e.K., Nordstraße 9, 49477 Ibbenbüren, VAT ID DE258830172",
   "vogt_immobilien": "Vogt Immobilien & Gewerbevermietung GmbH, Hammer Straße 300, 48153 Münster, VAT ID DE281164093",
   "stahlmann": "Stahlmann Werkzeughandel GmbH, Ruhrallee 17, 45138 Essen, VAT ID DE249906618",
   "feldkueche": "Feldküche Catering GmbH, Hansaring 61, 48155 Münster, VAT ID DE313347722",
   "nordpapier": "Nordpapier Großhandel GmbH, Überseering 8, 22297 Hamburg, VAT ID DE266058831",
   "unknown": "The document does not come from, and is not addressed to, exactly one of the listed suppliers (new supplier, private shop, bank, or scam)."
  }
 },
 "formally_complete": {
  "type": "noul",
  "instructions": "Is this a formally complete German invoice with supplier name and address, supplier VAT ID or tax number, invoice number, invoice date, line items, net amount, tax rate, tax amount and gross total all printed?"
 }
};
const EXTRACTION_PROMPT = "You extract booking data from documents received by the accounts payable team of Kessler Maschinenbau GmbH. The documents may be letters, e-mails, scans with recognition errors, table exports or XRechnung XML, in German or English.

Return one JSON object and nothing else, with these keys:
"vendor_name": supplier name as printed, or null,
"invoice_number": invoice number exactly as printed, or null if none is printed,
"invoice_date": date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, or null,
"net": net total as a number, or null,
"tax_rate": VAT rate in percent as a number (19 for 19 %), or null,
"tax": VAT amount as a number, or null,
"gross": gross total as a number, or null,
"summary": two short German sentences: what the document is about and what action it needs,
"notes": list of remarks that are not booking data (delivery notes, office hours, warnings)

Copy amounts exactly as printed, even when they do not add up. Never correct or recompute them. Use null for anything the document does not state.";

const form = $input.first().json;
const choice = form.document_choice;
const custom = String(form.custom_text || '').trim();
let text = choice === CUSTOM_OPTION ? custom : (SAMPLES[choice] || '');
if (FRESH_NUMBERS[choice]) {
  const fresh = FRESH_NUMBERS[choice].slice(0, -5) + String(Date.now()).slice(-5);
  text = text.split(FRESH_NUMBERS[choice]).join(fresh);
}
let problem = null;
if (!text) problem = 'Bitte einen Rechnungstext einfügen oder ein Testdokument wählen.';
else if (text.length > MAX_CHARACTERS) problem = `Der Text ist länger als ${MAX_CHARACTERS} Zeichen.`;

return [{
  json: {
    valid: problem === null,
    problem,
    source: choice === CUSTOM_OPTION ? 'custom' : choice,
    documentText: text,
    startedAt: Date.now(),
    jevRequest: { model: 'typesafe/jev', input: { state: text, questions: JEV_QUESTIONS } },
    haikuRequest: {
      model: "claude-haiku-5-5",
      max_tokens: 1500,
      thinking: { type: 'disabled' },
      system: EXTRACTION_PROMPT,
      messages: [{ role: 'user', content: `<document>
${text}
</document>` }],
    },
  },
}];

const prepared = $('Anfragen vorbereiten').first().json;
return [{ json: { jevMs: Date.now() - prepared.startedAt, haikuStartedAt: Date.now() } }];
